summary: Flattens a nested object into one level of dotted keys.
description: Nested objects become dotted paths; arrays are kept whole, because their indices are data rather than structure. `depth` stops the descent — `1` flattens the first level only.
The inverse walk is `getPath`, which reads a value back out by the same kind of path.

params.source: The object to flatten. It must not be an array.
params.depth: How many levels to descend. Any whole number; unlimited by default.

returns: a new flat object keyed by dotted paths.

throws.IllegalArgumentException: the value is not an object.
